full_name: Brian DeLay | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 History Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow UC Berkeley
bio: Brian DeLay is a historian who works at the intersection of US, Native American, and Latin American histories. At Radcliffe, he will work on a book explaining how unequal access to guns and ammunition conditioned the Western Hemisphere’s fateful struggles over freedom and domination prior to World War II.
